UP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

UP Police Constable Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Application Fee

  • सामान्य (General) : 13,093
  • अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC) : 8,818
  • अनुसूचित जाति (SC) : 6,857
  • अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) : 647
  • UP Police Constable : अभ्यर्थी को भारत के किसी मान्यता प्राप्त बोर्ड से 12वीं (इंटरमीडिएट) परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण होना चाहिए।
  • UR / OBC / SC : 168 सेमी
  • ST : 160 सेमी
  • UR / OBC / SC : 152 सेमी
  • ST : 147 सेमी

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
